lost-myself.name: Lost myself
lost-myself.line: I've spent so long looking after everyone else that I don't know what I want any more.
lost-myself.why: Keeps the loss of self but shows what it looks like day to day: a life spent on other people's needs, and no answer when someone asks what you want. The name also matches the ID again.

lost-myself.name: Who I am
lost-myself.line: I can't say what I like, what I want or who I am any more.
lost-myself.why: Stays close to the original and to people who lost themselves after a big change, not only through caregiving, while giving concrete things a person notices they can't answer.

procrastination.name: Follow-through
procrastination.line: I keep putting off the things that matter to me until it's too late.
procrastination.why: An area-style name so the Purpose heading doesn't mix problem and area labels, and a line that says what the putting off costs instead of only naming the habit.

stuck.name: Progress
stuck.line: I feel like my life isn't going anywhere, and each year looks like the last.
stuck.why: An area-style name so the heading reads one way, and a line that adds something to picture: years that look the same.
